_comment: Translations of the German table kampf_k23, written by tools/i18n/locales_kampf_k23.py. Keys are the English text; keys with %s or %d are patterns.

strings.Battle text waits for your tap at any sp: 任何速度下戰鬥文字都會等你點擊，每次結緣都是平靜的回聲。戰鬥中沒有任何計時。
strings.How long menus ignore taps after they ap: 選單出現後忽略點擊多長時間，免得手抖或遲到的點擊誤選。
strings.Nothing moves. Even the foe holds its br: 一切靜止。連對手都屏住了呼吸，不知是出於禮貌還是惡意。
strings.Saved before the boss. If it goes badly,: 已在首領戰前存檔。就算輸了，至少文書還在。
strings.Saving before the boss did not work this: 這次首領戰前的存檔沒有成功。
strings.The wild Spirling is still here. It wait: 野生的Spirling還在這裡。它一直在等，也沒有原諒你的離開。
